class.name: GameplayTagStackContainer
class.brief_description: Stores bounded counts of hierarchical gameplay tags for stacking effects and status snapshots.
class.description: Each exact tag stores a positive integer stack count. A non-exact lookup of a parent, such as [code]Runtime.Status[/code], sums counts of matching descendant tags on a dot boundary. This is useful for buffs, poison stacks, resolve and other counted states. Each tag is capped at 65535 stacks. Snapshot replacements validate all keys and values before mutating anything, and repeated identical snapshots do not emit a change notification.

method.name: add_stacks
method.description: Adds a positive number of stacks. Returns [code]false[/code] for invalid tags, counts or overflow; the old state remains unchanged.

method.name: remove_stacks
method.description: Removes up to [param count] stacks from the exact tag. Returns the number removed; zero-count tags are deleted.

method.name: get_stack_count
method.description: Returns the exact stack count, or the sum of stacks for [param tag] and all matching descendants when [param exact] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: has_tag
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the requested tag has positive stacks.

method.name: replace_stacks
method.description: Atomically replaces all counts using String or StringName keys and positive integer values up to 65535. Returns [code]false[/code] without altering the resource if any entry is invalid.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every stack. Does not notify listeners if already empty.

method.name: get_tag_count
method.description: Returns the number of exact tags with positive counts.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if there are no stacks.

members.member: A copy of the exact tag-to-count mapping. Mutating the retrieved dictionary does not change the resource.
